mainText: Hello, Verona! At 12 AM, here is today's balanced dish: expect clear skies tonight with a third quarter moon visible over the Verona Public Library. It is 46 degrees out, feeling closer to 41.

October is officially Community Planning Month in Verona. Mayor Diaz is recognizing our Planning and Development Department for their hard work in helping our city grow and managing land use effectively. Also, don't forget the Verona Senior Center offers a wonderful free tri-shaw bike program that lets you enjoy the Military Ridge State Trail.

Today you can enjoy the Dane County Farmers Market or live music at Bailey's Run, Paddy Mac's, and Wisconsin Brewing Company. Tomorrow, check out the World Dairy Expo or the apple cider pressing at the Farley Center Fall Festival.

In a noteworthy call from September 14, a 37-year-old Verona man was taken into custody during a traffic stop for violating the terms of his probation and was also cited for multiple traffic-related offences.
Treat yourself to today's Flavor of the Day, which is the decadent Really Reese's. The store opens today at 10:00 AM, so get ready to grab a scoop.
